title: Repeat a request safely
summary: REST API Development: Repeat a request safely. Compare setting a count with adding one to a count.
introduction: An idempotent operation has the same intended final effect when repeated. Setting pages to 30 twice leaves it at 30.
learningObjectives: Repeat a request safely with REST API Development
Compare setting a count with adding one to a count

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Repeat a request safely

blocks.text: Both requests set the same representation at the same URL. Repeating the assignment does not add another 30 pages.

blocks.title: Expected result
blocks.content: The page count remains 30 after both PUT requests.

blocks.text: Compare setting a count with adding one to a count.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Same final effect does not require every repeated response to have the same status.
